Commentary.Commentary: Sri Lanka have had a disappointing outing in the field today. Were quite inconsistent and poor with the ball and some sloppy efforts in the field did not help their cause either. The injury to Suranga Lakmal was an added blow to them. But, in today's time, a score of 300-plus is not so difficult to chase down. A good start for them and with the dew coming in, things could very well get interesting. Join us shortly for the run chase.

A phenomenal batting display from the Bangladesh side. Scoring 324 runs, that too after losing the toss, is not an easy feat by any means. But, in Bangladesh's defense, Mortaza anyway wanted to bat first. Tamim Iqbal stepped up today with a big hundred. He first got things going with Sabbir Rahman, who scored a brisk fifty, and made a brilliant 90-run stand, and then put on a mammoth partnership of 144 with Shakib Al Hasan, who really took the attack to the Lankans as the veteran showed his class. Some late hitting from Mosaddek and Mahmudullah towards the end was enough to put more than a good score on the board.
Full toss around off, Mahmudullah tries to push at it but manages to get it through the mid-wicket region off the inner half of the bat for a couple. SRI LANKA END ON 324-5.
The batsman drives this through the covers. They pick up a single.
SIX! Lucky! Short delivery into the body, Hossain goes for a wild swing and manages to top edge it over the fine leg region for a biggie.

Kumara follows the batsmen this time and bowls it down the leg side, Mosaddek clips it on the leg side for a single. The fielder from fine leg throws it back to the keeper's end and Chandimal tries to flick it onto the stumps cheekily but fails which helps the batsmen run another one.
Pushed on the off side for a single.
WIDE! Short and wide down the leg side, Mahmudullah goes for a pull but misses.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Mahmudullah fails to clip it. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Angling into the stumps, Mahmudullah works it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
FOUR! Good shot! Length delivery around off, Mosaddek makes room and cuts it through the point region for a boundary.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

SIX! Mahmudullah takes on Perera! Full in the line of the stumps, Mahmudullah slogs it over the deep backward square leg region for a biggie. The fielder there tried to reach it with a jump but it was way over him.
Full and wide outside off, Mosaddek drives it through extra covers for a single.
FOUR! No power, only placement! Fuller delivery in the line of the stumps, Mosaddek lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary. There was no stopping that.
Full into the pads, Mahmudullah misses his flick and gets rapped on the pads. The batsmen run a leg bye.
Mahmudullah guides it towards third man for a single.
Wide! Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Mahmudullah will be the new man in. 13 balls left in the innings. Can he provide a couple of lusty blows to end things?

OUT! Iqbal departs trying to smash it again! Another short ball this time, Iqbal goes for a pull again but this time manages to smack it straight to the fielder at long on. Gunathilaka makes no mistake and holds onto it. Iqbal has to walk back to the hut after a fantastic knock.
SIX! Lucky, lucky! Short delivery into the body, Tamim pulls this straight to the fielder at deep square leg. But Siriwardana could not latch onto it and the ball flew over the ropes for a biggie.
Short delivery angling into the body, Mosaddek stays deep in his crease and pushes it on the off side for a quick single.
Short ball and Tamim pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. He rotated nearly twice after hitting it. Just shows how much power he tried to generate there.
FOUR! Top shot! Length delivery into the pads, Tamim stays in his crease and just flicks it off his pads through the square leg region for a boundary.
Lahiru Kumara is back into the attack as Suranga Lakmal is back in the pavilion receiving treatment.
Yorker to end with, Tamim pushes it to the off side for a quick single.
On the pads, Mosaddek clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Tamim pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, Tamim lofts it over the bowler's head for a couple.
Full and into the stumps, Tamim smacks it back to the bowler and Perera stops it as he gets his right hand in the way.
FOUR! Tamim gets to normalcy! Full and wide full toss outside off, Tamim carves this one beautifully over the point region for a boundary.
Thisara Perera will have a change of ends.

FOUR! Misfield and that gets you a boundary! Lucky start for Mosaddek. Full into the stumps, he clips it towards short fine leg. Lahiru Kumara makes a mockery of it and lets it through to the boundary.
Mosaddek Hossain is the next batsman in.

OUT! Lakmal has the last laugh! Slower one around off, Shakib shuffles again but this time Lakmal gets the better of him. Beats him for lack of pace and Shakib manages to scoop it straight to the fielder at short fine leg. Sandakan pockets it with ease and an entertaining knock from Shakib comes to an end.
SIX! Sensational! Full and wide outside off, Shakib improvises as he reads the bowler's mind and shuffles wide across. Gets underneath that one and smashes it over the mid-wicket region for a biggie.
Back of a length delivery in the line of the stumps, Tamim mistimes his pull towards the fielder at long on for a single.

Suranga Lakmal has been hit hard on his fingers as he was protecting himself on that previous delivery. The physio is out to treat him now. Lucky he didn't get hit on the face. Would have been nasty, that.

OUCH! Full and wide outside off, Shakib smashes this one back to the bowler. Suranga Lakmal tried his level best to get out of the way but he got his hand to it. That's gonna hurt him for sure. The batsmen run a single in the process as the ball ricochets towards the point region.
Way wide outside off, just inside the wide line. Shakib tries his level best to reach at it but it was just too far for him.
Suranga Lakmal is back into the attack.
Shakib misses out on a full toss as he just manages to drive it towards the fielder at deep cover for a single. Costliest over of the match till now. 15 runs off it.
FOUR! Gets even better this time! Full from Kumara, Shakib stands and delivers a beauty. He just lofts it over the mid off fielder. The ball goes one bounce across the rope.
FOUR! This was powerful! Full in the line of the stumps, Shakib stays in his crease and clobbers it down the ground through the mid on region for a boundary.
FOUR! Easy runs! Sprayed down the leg side, Shakib pulls it towards fine leg. Sachith Pathirana tries to stop it with a dive but the ball races away to the boundary.
Eased down to long on for a single.
Low full toss down the leg side, Shakib stays in his crease and manages to just get it through the square leg region for a single.
Length ball down the leg side, Shakib plays a paddle sweep towards fine leg for a single.
Full toss outside off, Iqbal smashes it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Iqbal goes for a wild swing but misses it completely.
FOUR! Placement! Length ball outside off, Iqbal lofts it beautifully over the cover region for a boundary.
33rd ODI fifty for Shakib Al Hasan!
Fifty for Shakib! This man has been in sublime form and has made it count. Shakib nudges it fine down the leg side for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Angling into the pads, Shakib gets an inside edge onto his pads and then the ball rolls away through the vacant slip cordon. The batsmen pick up a single as Tamim denies Shakib the second run.

NOT OUT! Pitched down the leg side, Shakib shuffles and tries to clip it on the leg side. He misses and gets rapped on the pads. The bowler is quick to appeal but the umpire denies it. Sri Lanka opt for the review. Replays show that there was no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows that it pitched outside leg so the umpire's decision stands.
Review from Sri Lanka, for an lbw appeal. Looked to be going down leg and pitched outside leg too. Let's see what happens now...

NOT OUT! Length delivery outside off, Tamim pushes it towards mid off and rushes for a single. The fielder there picks it up and has a shy at the stumps. He hits and the umpire is quick to go upstairs for a run out appeal. Replays show Tamim was well inside to complete his run.
A run out appeal against Tamim Iqbal is referred upstairs by the umpire.
Short delivery outside off, Shakib lofts it over the keeper's head towards third man for a single.

Hundred for Iqbal! Back of a length delivery down the leg side, Tamim nudges it fine down the leg side for a single and that takes him to his hundred. He is delighted, takes off the helmet and cherishes the moment. He still looks composed and will want to now tear the opposition apart with some aggresive batting.
On the pads, Shakib works it towards square leg for a single.

Short and wide outside off, Shakib punches it a bit square on the off side. Sweeper cover runs to his right and cuts it off. The batsmen take two.
Outside off on a driving length, it's pushed to the covers. No run taken.
Moves on to 99 with that. Drives it through the covers for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Hit that with absolute disdain. Short, flat and into the body, Iqbal picks the length early and rocks back. Muscles the pull through mid-wicket and sends it across the boundary line.

Wide down the leg side, Shakib shuffles and nudges it through the square leg region for a couple.

Short delivery and Shakib punches it back to the bowler.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Back of a length delivery on the pads bowled at 129 kph, Tamim clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple. He is in the nervous nineties.
Pushed towards the fielder at point this time.
Back of a length delivery down the leg side, Shakib short arm jabs it through square leg for a single.

Full in the line of the stumps, Iqbal eases it down towards long off for a single.

FOUR! That's poor from Kumara, very poor. Tamim Iqbal drives this through extra cover. Kumara at wide long off gets to the ball but lets it through him.

FOUR! In the air but that's hit hard and in the gap. Darts this full outside off, Tamim powerfully drives this aerially over the covers. The fielder attempted to stop it with a diving attempt but only in vain. Raced away to the fence like a rocket.

Outside off, on a flatter trajectory, Tamim initially went to play at it but then withdrew his bat to let it be.

Full around off, Iqbal drives it to the right of the bowler. A misfield from the bowler allows the batsmen to take a single.
Sliding in on middle and leg, Shakib Al Hasan backs away and punches it through covers for a run.

Six singles, six balls. The scoreboard has been kept ticking here. Played to long off once more and that will be the end of the over.
Drives this full delivery to long off for one more.
Sensible stuff. The fourth single in 4 balls now. Cuts this away towards deep backward point and the batsmen just jog across to the other end.
Another single as Tamim has no trouble punching this down to long off.
Slower outside off, driven through covers for a run.
Cutter spinning across Tamim Iqbal, he stands his ground and punches it to long off for one.
Stays back to this shorter delivery and keeps it out with a straight blade.
Takes a big stride forward to this fuller length delivery and pushes it to long off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Too full from Danushka, it's drilled down to long off for one. Sensibly done.
Full and bowled quicker on middle and leg, driven to long on for a single.
Starts off from around the wicket and bowls it flat on middle, Tamim gets back and flicks it through mid-wicket. There's a big boundary out there so he easily comes back for the second.
Danushka Gunathilaka is into the bowling attack.
Punched off the back foot down to long off by Tamim Iqbal. A single is taken and that will be the end of the over.
Very loopy on the pads, nudged away on the leg side. No run taken.
Lands this on a driving length, invites Iqbal forward to defend and he obliges.
Looped up on off, it's driven to long off for a single.
35th fifty for Tamim Iqbal.
Fifty for Tamim! It's come at a steady pace but he's gotten to the milestone and is still out there. Needs to carry on though. Full on the stumps, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one run.
Drops this short and well outside off, some width on offer as Shakib cuts it to sweeper cover for one.
Full and some dip on that occasion, Tamim presents the full face of the bat to defend.
Tamim Iqbal has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Just like the previous delivery, only done in a more elegant fashion this time. Reaches out and pushes it to the cover fielder.
Full and outside off, pushed to cover.

Darts it full on off, a bit quicker through the air, it's blocked.
Shakib Al Hasan presents a tight front foot defensive shot and sees the over out comfortably.
Takes a step across, comes ahead and just wrists this back down to the long on fielder for a single.
Just back of a driving length, outside off, Tamim Iqbal cuts it away but it's straight to the point fielder.
Beaten! Almost. Rolls his fingers on that and gets it to spin away, Tamim is forward in defense but is beaten past the outside edge.
Cutter going away from the batsman, he goes back and cuts it behind square on the off side for one.
Bowls this on the pads, tucked to the square leg region for an easy one.
Leans ahead and nicely wrists this to the deep mid-wicket fielder for a run.
The batsman has driven it to mid off.
Leans ahead to this loopy delivery and blocks it off the front foot.
Flighted delivery just around off, eased to long off for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Shakib goes back and cuts it through towards sweeper cover for a couple of runs. Off the mark without wasting any time.
Shakib Al Hasan makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! HE'S GONE! This is a big moment in the game. Mushfiqur Rahim is gone! A great appeal from Sri Lanka, not sure who caught that but credit to whoever did. Eagle's Eye. It's full on the stumps, Rahim drives it straight back to the bowler. He catches it and the home side appeals. They are sure they have got their man and so, they appeal. The umpire isn't sure and after talking about it with the square leg umpire, they decide to refer it upstairs. And replays show, much to Rahim's dismay, that there is no bump and he is gone. Two quick wickets for Sri Lanka here.

The umpire has gone upstairs for a caught and bowled appeal! Mushfiqur Rahim has played it back to the bowler and the Lankans have appealed. Not sure if there is a bump or not. Over to the TV umpire now. Looks close...
On the pads this time, Iqbal clips it towards short fine leg and calls for a single. Rahim is quick to send him back.
In the line of the stumps, Tamim stays in his crease and guides it towards the fielder at short third man.

Mushfiqur Rahim is the next man in to bat.

OUT! Upul Tharanga pulls off a stunner! Fuller delivery outside off, Rahman stays in his crease and drives it uppishly to covers. Upul Tharanga dives to his left and takes a stunning catch. Rahman has thrown it away after such a good knock. The dibbly dobbly bowler creates magic. Seems like anything Gunaratne touches these days turns into gold!

Full ball outside off, driven to mid off to end the over.
Sweeps again but this time finds the fielder positioned at backward square leg.

Outside off, played to point for nought.
Full on the stumps, looks to sweep it away but it gets off the toe end towards the bowler.

4th ODI fifty for Sabbir Rahman.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single. A stunning knock from Sabbir Rahman here, has been good and batted with a positive intent. Lovely stuff.
Leans ahead and drives this full delivery to long on for one.
Darted full around off, Tamim looks to play the reverse sweep but just gets it off his gloves to the keeper.
Short ball pitched outside off, goes back and punches it down to long off for a run.
Steps out to play, doesn't quite get to the pitch and so is hit low on the pads.

Five Wides! That's missed everyone. Pathirana from around the wicket bowls it full down the leg side, Sabbir looks to flick but misses and so does the keeper. It races away behind to the fence for a boundary.
Picks it up well and nudges it to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Innovative from Sabbir! He kneels down to this quicker delivery and connects the reverse sweep well. Plays it through to the third man fence for a boundary.
Driven down to long off for an easy run.

Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Loopy and a bit fullish in length, Iqbal wrists it to mid on but for no run.
Outside off, going across, it's punched to the covers.

Close. Bit risky from Tamim Iqbal. Pathirana comes from around the wicket and gives this a lot of flight as he tosses it up on middle and leg, Tamim makes room, steps out a bit and looks to slog it hard. Can only manage an inside edge which runs down towards fine leg. Two runs taken.

NOT OUT! A good review from Sabbir to say the least. Shocking decision from the umpire in hindsight. He actually got that off the bat, there was no pad involved there.

Shortish delivery outside off, makes room and cuts it away through to sweeper cover for a run.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full delivery darted outside off, drilled through to deep cover for a single.

50-run stand between Tamim and Sabbir!
Punched to long off for a single.
FOUR! Rahman is on the charge! Full and wide outside off, Rahman gets under that one and drives it over the cover fielders for a boundary.

Driven down to long on for a single.

Again down the leg side, Tamim flicks it through the square leg region for a single.
Floated in the line of the pads, Tamim clips it straight to the fielder at mid on.
Sachith Pathirana is introduced into the bowling attack. First signs of spin for the Lankans.
Around off this time, Sabbir Rahman stays deep in his crease and defends it.
Slower delivery outside off at 100 kph, Sabbir reads it well and defends it towards covers.
Back of a length delivery bowled at 138 kph, Sabbir stands deep in his crease and defends it.

Fuller delivery outside off, Iqbal prods forward and defends it.
Thisara Perera is back into the attack.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. That means a maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the circle.
FOUR! Finesse! Angling into the hips, Rahman works it fine down the leg side to beat the short third man fielder for a boundary.

Fuller delivery outside off, Iqbal goes for a drive but ends up getting it down the ground towards mid on off the inner half of the bat. The fielder there makes a fine diving stop to save three runs for his team.
Angling into the stumps from a length, Iqbal stays in his crease and defends it.
Fuller delivery around off, Iqbal drives it to the fielder at mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! Width outside off this time, Iqbal loves that length as he cuts it through the point region for a boundary.
Lahiru Kumara will come back on to bowl now.
Length delivery outside off, Rahman uses his crease and defends it well.
FOUR! Fortune favours the brave! Good length delivery outside off, Sabbir goes for a pull and he finds an inside edge which runs past the keeper for a boundary. Lakmal is disappointed.
Angling into the pads, Sabbir defends it on the leg side. Lakmal seems charged up when Sabbir is batting.
Full down the leg side, Tamim clips it fine. Sandakan, at short fine leg dives to his right to stop a certain boundary. The batsmen run a single.
Length delivery outside off, Tamim prods forward and defends it towards covers.
Angling into the pads, Tamim clips it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Three in three for Sabbir! Rahman smashes the ball way outside off over the cover region and gets another boundary under his belt. 13 runs off the over. A big one for the visitors.
FOUR! Sign of brilliance! A bit short this time, Sabbir gets behind the ball and pulls it beautifully through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
FOUR! Width and thrashed! Fuller delivery outside off, Sabbir stays in his crease, trusts the bounce well and smacks that over the mid off region for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, Sabbir places the full face of his bat to block it.
Sprayed on the pads this time, Tamim flicks it through the square leg region. A single is taken.
Good length delivery around off, Tamim uses his crease well to defend it.
Thisara Perera comes into the bowling attack.
Good length delivery outside off, Rahman stays deep in his crease and punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Length delivery outside off, Rahman tries to push at it and he gets an inside edge into his pads.
FOUR! Best way to get off the mark! Back of a length delivery from Lamkal, Rahman smells the bad length and pulls it with brute force through the square leg region for a boundary.
Rahman stays deep in his crease and presents the full face of the bat to defend it.
Fuller length delivery outside off, nips away a bit. Rahman gets behind the line of the ball and pushes it towards mid on.
Good length delivery outside off, Tamim cuts it past point for a single.
Fuller into the pads, Rahman clips it on the leg side. The fielder at mid-wicket dives to his left and makes a fine stop.
Miscued by Sabbir. He goes for the pull shot and ends up getting it off the toe end towards the covers.
Length delivery outside off, Sabbir stays deep in his crease and pushes it to the fielder at covers.
Fuller ball this time, darting into the stumps, Sabbir pushes this one to the fielder at mid on.
Length delivery angling across, Tamim shuffles a bit and clips it through to deep square leg for a single.
Low full toss around off, Tamim just gets his bat down in time and blocks it away through the mid-wicket region. A couple of runs taken.
Finally some movement there with the new ball. Length delivery outside off and nipping away, Sabbir covers his stumps and lets it through to the keeper.
Good length delivery, Sabbir Rahman, the new man shoulders his arms to it.
Sabbir Rahman walks in at No.3.

OUT! Lakmal comes 'round the wicket this time and that does the trick for him! Angling in from a length, Sarkar prods forward and tries to clip it on the leg side. He gets the leading edge and the ball flies straight towards the keeper. Chandimal won't miss those and Sarkar has to make the long way back to the pavilion. Lakmal draws first blood of the encounter.
FOUR! Risky but worthy! Length delivery outside off, Sarkar reaches to it and just carves it over the cover-point region for a boundary.
A bit fuller this time, Sarkar covers his timber and defends it. No real movement to trouble the batsman.
Good length delivery around off, Soumya stays deep in his crease to defend it.
FOUR! Improvisation! Back of a length delivery, Iqbal stays deep in his crease and cuts it really late through the vacant slip region for a boundary. The tigers are dealing in boundaries.
No swing there. On a length outside off, Iqbal lunges forward and defends it on the off side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Timed to perfection! Angling into the pads, Tamim Iqbal just clips it off his pads through the square leg region. Sandakan from fine leg and Pathirana from mid-wicket give it a chase and they both dive to just see the ball roll over the fence.
Short delivery around off, Iqbal stays deep and defends it well.
A bit back of a length angling across off, Tamim stays deep in his crease and defends it well.
Fuller delivery outside off, Sarkar prods a bit forward and defends it well.
FOUR! Effortless this time! Length delivery outside off, Sarkar pushes this one from the cover-point region for a boundary. No stopping those.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Sarkar plays a needless shot. He drives it uppishly through the cover region for a couple. Lucky not to find the fielder there.
Again from the middle of the bat, Sarkar pushes the ball outside off to the fielder at covers.
A bit wide outside off on a similar length, Sarkar drives it straight to the fielder at mid off.
Fuller length to start the over with, Soumya gets behind the line of the ball and defends it with the full face of his bat.
Pushed towards point from the crease.

FOUR! Elegance and first boundary from the bat! Fuller delivery outside off, Iqbal leans into the drive and plays it through covers. There were two fielders giving it a chase but the ball was always winning the race.
Iqbal prods forward this time and defends it off the front foot.
Leg bye! Again on the pads, Sarkar fails to make contact with his flick. The ball runs towards square leg off the pads and the batsmen run a leg bye.

Four Leg byes! Free runs! Down the leg side and that will be runs for sure. Sarkar tries to clip it off his pads but fails to make contact. The ball clips the pads and races away to the boundary. The diving keeper could just manage to touch the gloves on it.
Good length delivery angling across, Soumya stays tall in his crease and defends it on the off side. No movement there.
Lahiru Kumara will bowl from the other end with the second new ball. Has two slips in place.
Swing and a miss this time! Good length delivery angling away, Tamim stays in his crease and tries to push hard at it but is beaten by the away movement. Luckily misses the edge by a margin.
Fuller this time around off, Iqbal prods forward and drives it towards the fielder at mid off. No runs taken.
Good length delivery wide outside off, Iqbal shoulders his arms to it. Lakmal is trying to make Iqbal play outside off.
First runs for Bangladesh! A length ball down the leg side, Iqbal shuffles and clips it through the square leg region for a couple.
This one angles across off on a fuller length, Tamim Iqbal covers his stumps and lets it through to the keeper.
Fuller delivery to start with and a bit of swing is visible. Tamim Iqbal prods forward to defend the ball. A good seam movement was visible there.
The players are out in the middle. Tamim Iqbal and Soumya Sarkar will open with the bat for Bangladesh. Suranga Lakmal will start the proceedings with the ball for Sri Lanka.
Both teams are now standing out in a queue for their respective National Anthems. We will begin with the home side's first.

Mashrafe Mortaza says that he would have wanted to bat first. Praises his guys for playing really good cricket. Adds that the players should be used to the conditions as most of them played the Tests as well. Ends by saying that they will want to have a really good start.

Upul Tharanga says it looks a very good wicket and thinks the dew will come into play later. Mentions the surface looks quite dry right now. On never having a set playing XI, he says his players need to be prepared for whatever happens and can't think about the selection process. When asked about the record at this venue in the last few matches, he states he didn't notice anything of the sort and chose to field because of the conditions. Adds the one place they need to focus on is that they need to convert their starts into big scores.

TOSS - SRI LANKA WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BOWL FIRST! They have several changes in their side, the most noticeable of them would be that of Kusal Perera, who is missing out through injury. Bangladesh have more or less the same squad, so will have players already acclimatized to the conditions. Mehedi Hasan makes his ODI debut for the visitors.

Pitch report - Russel Arnold doing the pitch report says that the deck is a hard one and on the drier side. Also feels that there are quite some cracks on the surface. Observes that there is no wind blowing. Opines that there should be dew later in the match. Ends by saying that he would put the opposition to bat first after winning the toss.

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of the first of the 3-match ODI series between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh in Dambulla. The visitors after their dream win in the second Test will want to emulate the same form as they head to the 50-over format and their favourite one as well. Sri Lanka, on the other hand will want to seek revenge with a comparatively inexperienced side. But the Lions in their own den, in the ODIs, can roar against any team in the world. Promises to be an exciting game of cricket. Stay tuned for the toss.
